title: Monthly Project Health Report Agent — From Excel Data Pack to Director Dashboard
tagline: Same data pack, different user views: Director sees exceptions; PM sees actions; QS sees commercial detail.
ai_role: Validate, calculate, narrate, render — never sign
human_owner: Project Manager (final approver); Section owners: Planner, QS, Safety Officer, QAQC, Procurement Manager, Technical Manager
ai_tasks: Validate required columns, missing values, formula errors
Normalize status labels (e.g., OPEN / open / Pending / pending)
Calculate KPI: planned vs actual progress, delay days, overdue RFI, procurement variance, safety / quality exceptions, GP, cashflow, commitment
Generate charts: progress bar, milestone delay, RFI aging, commercial dashboard, RAG donut, cashflow snapshot
Render premium HTML (self-contained, base64-inlined charts), Markdown, HTML, PDF draft
Run Visual QA on rendered charts (Gemini Vision asks: are labels, numbers, axes readable and unclipped?)

review_gates.what_to_check: Overall narrative is fair and complete

review_gates.stop_condition: Red progress item has no recovery action
Critical path milestone delay not flagged Red
Overdue RFI with programme impact not escalated
Red safety item missing owner, due date, or evidence

review_gates.what_to_check: GP, VO, cashflow figures and wording
review_gates.stop_condition: Commercial number conflicts with QS records

review_gates.what_to_check: Every chart's labels, numbers, axes, legend, and title are clearly readable and unclipped
review_gates.stop_condition: Any chart fails Visual QA — labels clipped, numbers hidden behind donut hole, axis ticks overlapping, etc.

review_gates.what_to_check: Approves Director Executive Dashboard before issue
review_gates.stop_condition: Any of the above gates remain blocked
